text: Can you help with something? What is the site for the depot where label printing stalled in the carrier API outage at Tansley Parcel? Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:
The depot is Southgate. I replied in the thread on your message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

The only carrier API outage recorded in that channel is the 3 September 2025 incident. It stalled label printing at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding totes by door 4. It was closed that evening after Southgate cleared the backlog. If the customer call is about a newer outage, I can't see one, so confirm the date with Priyanka or Hollis.
